semiconductor_relevance: High — Shanghai Shengjian Technology provides critical chemical solutions and facility systems for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Shanghai Shengjian Technology is a leading provider of green high-tech solutions and chemical systems for the semiconductor industry. They offer a range of services including exhaust systems, chemical dispensing systems, and solvent recovery systems, catering to various high-tech sectors.

regional_presence.China: The company has six manufacturing centers in China, focusing on equipment and chemical solutions.
regional_presence.Singapore: Shengjian Technology established its overseas headquarters in Singapore in 2024.
